rationale: Wave 1 found no PSE, ERE, Massenentlassung or union dispute, and only scattered dated closures. Wave 2 goes after the primary documents behind the strongest open leads and adds sources wave 1 did not touch. (1) The French APC (an anonymous Instagram account, tier C) would be Tier A if it can be found in a filed ACCO deposit, a union tract or a court decision. (2) About 10 French closures are dated by the locator but have no press confirmation. (3) The German, Dutch and Belgian named closures still lack dates, and the German works council (Betriebsrat) is an untested labour-court channel. (4) The European Works Council and the Dutch OR have statutory rights to be consulted on a sale of FL Europe B.V., which is the most direct labour tell for thesis 1, and no wave-1 avenue covered them. (5) In Iberia, the regional unions beyond ELA and Spain's REGCON registry of collective agreements were never searched, and several Spanish and Portuguese closures are undated. (6) UK and Irish council planning and committee papers are a new primary-document source for lease surrenders and re-lets. Italy is excluded: two independent counts put it flat (154), and wave 1 was exhaustive there.

tasks.title: France: corroborate the Foot Locker France APC (collective performance agreement) from primary labour documents
tasks.instructions:
Goal: confirm or refute, with PRIMARY documents, that Foot Locker France SAS (SIREN 382401867; parent FL France Holdings SAS, SIREN 480023324) negotiated or signed an Accord de Performance Collective (APC, art. L2254-2 Code du travail) in summer-autumn 2026. The only current source is an anonymous Instagram account, @awareness.see (posts 2026-07-31 to 2026-08-05, hashtags #APC #AccordDePerformance). It describes a mandatory national mobility clause (3 months' notice), removal of individual sales commission, changes to the 13th month and annualised part-time hours. An APC with a national mobility clause lets a company close stores and redeploy or shed staff without a PSE, so it matters for European closures running above consensus.

ALREADY KNOWN (do not report as new): no PSE, RCC or DREETS/RUPCO notice was found. The latest FL France accord found in DILA ACCO / Doctrine is the NAO-2023 pay accord (signed 2024-09-26, effective 2024-11-01; 10 company agreements in total). The 2024 signatories were CFDT, UNSA and CAT. CGT Commerce has no FL communiqué since the 2023 CSE elections, and the CAT and UNSA Foot Locker LinkedIn accounts have been inactive since 2024. FL France headcount was 1,669 → 1,634 (equal-pay index posters). BODACC of 2026-04-21 records a governance change (Matthew Barnes and Erik Amperse).

STEPS:
1. DILA ACCO open data: list https://echanges.dila.gouv.fr/OPENDATA/ACCO/ and download every incremental archive dated 2026-07-01 to today (ACCO_YYYYMMDD-HHMMSS.tar.gz). Extract them and grep the XML for 382401867, 480023324, 'FOOT LOCKER' and 'FL FRANCE'. For any hit, record the accord title, theme codes (look for 'performance collective', 'mobilite', 'remuneration', 'temps de travail', 'amenagement du temps'), signature date, deposit date and signatory unions. Also query Legifrance's accords d'entreprise search (https://www.legifrance.gouv.fr/liste/acco) for 'Foot Locker' sorted by date. Note: deposits typically lag signature by 2-8 weeks, and an APC needs signatures from unions totalling >50% at the last CSE elections.
2. Union channels: search the websites, Facebook pages, Instagram and LinkedIn of CFDT Services, the Fédération des Services CFDT, UNSA Commerce et Services, the CAT (Confédération Autonome du Travail), FO Fédération des employés et cadres (FEC-FO), CGT Commerce et Services and the CGT Paris commerce unions for 'Foot Locker' 2026 together with APC, 'accord de performance', mobilité, commission, 'prime sur ventes', 13e mois, annualisation, NAO 2026, 'droit d'alerte', 'expertise CSE' and 'consultation CSE'. A CSE vote to appoint an expert (expertise économique/comptable) under the DKS integration is also a Tier A/B signal.
3. Employee voice: re-open @awareness.see and capture every post after 2026-08-05 (sign-up count, signature date, refusals). A refusal of an APC mobility clause leads to a licenciement sui generis. Search TikTok and Instagram for 'Foot Locker APC', 'Foot Locker mobilité', 'Foot Locker accord' and 'Foot Locker licenciement 2026' in French.
4. Court decisions: query the Judilibre open API (https://www.courdecassation.fr/acces-rapide-judilibre; also cours d'appel decisions) and Légifrance JURI for 'Foot Locker France' decisions dated 2025-2026. Look for mobility-clause disputes, licenciement pour motif économique or store-closure dismissals, and capture case number, date, store and quoted reasoning. Also check conseil de prud'hommes coverage in local press.
5. Look for any CSE-election or bargaining news: the 2023 CSE mandate runs to 2027, and early elections would follow a reorganisation.

OUTPUT: for each finding give source URL, date, verbatim French quote plus English translation, and tier (A = filed accord, court decision or union tract on letterhead; B = named press or union social post; C = anonymous). Report negatives explicitly, e.g. 'ACCO archives 2026-07-01..2026-10-07 contain no FL deposit'. Tooling: WebSearch/WebFetch, with python requests as fallback. If a site blocks you, try the Apify RAG browser or Google cache, and log what failed.

tasks.title: France: date and confirm the post-deal store closures named by the locator, using local press, mall and landlord sources
tasks.instructions:
Goal: turn locator-only French closures into press- or landlord-confirmed, dated closures (Tier A/B), and find any French closure not yet known. Context: the French FL locator went from 149 stores on deal-close day (2025-09-08) to 140-142 live (2026-10-07). Bloomberg consensus models Europe flat at ~550 stores through FY32, so every dated post-deal closure matters.

ALREADY CONFIRMED (do not re-report except to add a precise date or reason): Avignon 9 rue des Marchands (closed 2026-09-15, 4 staff redeployed); Marseille Centre Bourse (closed end-2025, FNAC taking the unit); Lyon Confluence (re-let to Adidas); Paris Bastille 12 rue du Faubourg Saint-Antoine (summer 2025); Chartres rue Marceau (June 2025); Marseille Saint-Ferréol move (July 2024). Reims was refitted. Nîmes 2 av. Perrier is still open.

TARGETS (locator-dated, unconfirmed): Paris 66 rue de Rivoli 'Hôtel de Ville' (05352; last live 2026-04-15); Metz 5358 (removed ~2026-05-18); Mulhouse 24 rue des Maréchaux (05177); Les Ulis, Ulis 2 (05134); Fresnes, 1 rue de la Loge (0530x); Lille Euralille Kids FL (65118), including whether it was merged into the adult store; Strasbourg rue du Vieux-Marché-aux-Vins; Rouen Docks 76; Aulnay-sous-Bois O'Parinor Kids FL (all days closed on the locator). Also check the remaining Kids Foot Locker doors in France (Thiais Belle Épine 65128, Marseille Grand Littoral 65135, Besançon, Cabriès Plan de Campagne) for closures or conversions.

SOURCES AND METHODS:
1. Local press, searched in French with the store name plus 'Foot Locker' and 'ferme', 'fermeture', 'a fermé', 'baisse le rideau', 'ferme ses portes', 'remplacé par', 'à la place de', 'ex-Foot Locker', 'local vacant'. Titles: Le Parisien (Essonne for Les Ulis, Val-de-Marne for Fresnes, Seine-Saint-Denis for Aulnay), Actu.fr (76actu, Lille actu), Paris-Normandie, DNA, Rue89 Strasbourg, Pokaa, Républicain Lorrain, L'Alsace, La Voix du Nord, Lille actu, La Provence, Est Républicain. Most of these block WebFetch, so use the Apify RAG web browser, Google News RSS (https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=...&hl=fr&gl=FR), or python with a browser user-agent.
2. Mall and landlord directories: Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield (Euralille, Rosny 2), the Ulis 2 centre operator for Les Ulis, Klépierre, Ceetrus/Nhood (Docks 76 Rouen), Altarea, Carmila, Hammerson (O'Parinor, Les Terrasses), Frey and Mercialys. Check whether /boutiques/foot-locker pages return 404, are blank or show 'nouvelle enseigne', and capture Wayback last-seen dates where possible.
3. Leasing listings for ex-FL units: search JLL, CBRE, Cushman & Wakefield, BNP Paribas Real Estate, Imm'Sud and Bureaux Locaux for 'ex Foot Locker' / 'ancien Foot Locker' 2025-2026. Check whether Imm'Sud's Strasbourg 540 m2 unit (EUR360k/yr) is the former FL Vieux-Marché-aux-Vins. Record the availability date.
4. Commercial-lease notices: BODACC/annonces légales for 'cession de droit au bail' on any of the target addresses (the assignee, date and price give the exit date).
5. Planning: Paris and other mairies publish 'enseignes' and 'déclarations préalables' for the new occupant's shopfront, which gives a re-let date.

OUTPUT per store: store ID, address, closure date (best evidence), reason, successor tenant, source URL, verbatim quote plus translation, and tier. Also give a net-count reconciliation: confirmed French post-deal closures vs openings (Neyrpic 05342, Forum des Halles Porte Berger 05377, Bobigny La Place).

tasks.title: Germany/Benelux/Switzerland: works-council and labour-court trail, plus dating of named undated closures
tasks.instructions:
Goal: (a) find any German or Benelux works-council, labour-court or co-determination evidence of a closure programme or sale preparation at Foot Locker Germany GmbH & Co. KG (HRA 4942 Recklinghausen) and its Benelux/Swiss affiliates, and (b) date the named but undated closures. Context: Germany fell 89 → 84 → 79-82 locator stores (Aug-2025 → Oct-2026, about -7%/yr, faster than the ~4%/yr EMEA run-rate in the brief). German CY2025 revenue was -13.3%, average headcount fell 1,322 → 1,199, and leases are short (~3 years weighted).

ALREADY KNOWN (do not re-report): Nürnberg Breite Gasse (Jan-2026), Osnabrück Große Str. (Mar-2026), Fulda Bahnhofstr. (May-2026), Forum Wetzlar, Ingolstadt Ludwigstr. re-let to Telekom, and the ECE directory removals at Alstertal Hamburg, Wetzlar and pep München. Ulm Blautal-Center (03187) is set to all-days-closed. Mannheim Planken was fire-closed in Jun-2025. Liège Vinâve d'Île closed Apr-2023. There was a 2025 union-busting prosecution at Amtsgericht Tiergarten. No ver.di, FNV, CNV, ACV, BBTK or Unia statements and no Massenentlassungsanzeige were found in wave 1.

PART A, labour channels:
1. Search arbeitsunrecht.de, labournet.de, the ver.di Handel Berlin and NRW pages, ver.di publik, the Rosa-Luxemburg-Stiftung and taz for 'Foot Locker' with Betriebsrat, Gesamtbetriebsrat, Interessenausgleich, Sozialplan, Einigungsstelle, Betriebsänderung, Filialschließung, Kündigung or Union Busting, 2025-2026. Find the outcome or verdict of the Amtsgericht Tiergarten case (§119 BetrVG) and any Arbeitsgericht or Landesarbeitsgericht decision involving Foot Locker Germany. Query the open-justice databases openjur.de, dejure.org and rechtsprechung-im-internet.de, and the NRW and Berlin-Brandenburg court databases.
2. Netherlands and Belgium: check rechtspraak.nl for 2025-26 rulings involving Foot Locker Europe B.V. or Foot Locker Netherlands (kantonrechter dismissals, OR disputes). Check juportal.be for Foot Locker Belgium. Search Dutch and Belgian local press for 'Foot Locker sluit' / 'Foot Locker ferme' 2026.
3. Switzerland: the Swiss web presence is offline (stores.footlocker.ch NXDOMAIN; footlocker.ch Fastly 421), yet the careers feed shows 9 Swiss store numbers. Search 20 Minuten, Blick, Tages-Anzeiger, NZZ, Le Temps, 24 heures, RTS and RSI, plus mall directories (Glattzentrum, Sihlcity, Westside, Shoppi Tivoli, Balexert, Manor-linked malls), for 'Foot Locker schliesst' / 'Foot Locker ferme' 2025-2026. Establish whether FL Switzerland is being wound down; Swiss stores are not in the 14-country locator census.

PART B, dating named undated closures. Use local press (via Google News RSS in German, e.g. https://news.google.com/rss/search?q=%22Foot+Locker%22+schlie%C3%9Ft&hl=de&gl=DE), mall websites and Instagram:
- Göttingen, Wolfsburg and Kaiserslautern (claimed in a Göttinger Tageblatt Instagram comment; none is in the live DE sitemap): look for Göttinger Tageblatt, Wolfsburger Nachrichten / WAZ Wolfsburg and Die Rheinpfalz articles, plus mall directories (Designer Outlets Wolfsburg, City-Galerie Wolfsburg, K in Lautern).
- Koblenz Löhr-Center (flagged permanently closed on Cybo, 2026-05): Rhein-Zeitung; check the Löhr-Center shop directory.
- Sindelfingen Breuningerland: Sindelfinger Zeitung / SZBZ; check the Breuningerland directory.
- Mönchengladbach: find the RP/WZ (Rheinische Post) article behind the 2026-10-01 Instagram reel about a Jan-2027 re-let of the former FL space.
- Ulm Blautal-Center: Südwest Presse.
- Utrecht Oudegracht (a Pepper.com post of 2026-07-21 says the store is closing): DUIC, AD Utrechts Nieuwsblad.
- Hamburg Alstertal and München pep: Hamburger Abendblatt, Abendzeitung, tz.

tasks.title: European Works Council and Dutch OR: information-and-consultation trail on any FL Europe sale, licensing or restructuring
tasks.instructions:
Goal: find evidence that the Foot Locker European Works Council (EWC/SE-type transnational body) or the Dutch ondernemingsraad (OR) of Foot Locker Europe B.V. (KvK 23067735, Utrecht EMEA HQ) has been informed or consulted about a transnational restructuring, a sale or licensing of FL Europe, or a store-closure programme since DKS closed the deal (2025-09-08). Under EU Directive 2009/38/EC and the Dutch WOR (Art. 25: sale or transfer of control, closure, major reorganisation), management must request OR advice BEFORE a sale decision. An OR adviesaanvraag or an EWC extraordinary meeting is therefore the most direct labour tell for thesis 1 (DKS exits or licenses FL Europe).

ALREADY KNOWN (do not re-report): Jill Maclaren is an FL Europe OR member and former chair. Wave 1 found no FNV or CNV statements, no layoffs at Utrecht HQ or the Haps DC, and Haps still recruiting temps at EUR14.99/h. Since 2026-09-10, 5 of 7 Utrecht corporate postings are fixed-term '(T)'. The EMEA CFO and HR head have left board seats. Company.info flags a KvK management change on 2026-10-02 at FL Europe B.V. The Spanish holding was merged into Foot Locker Dutch Holdings B.V. (2026-08-28).

STEPS:
1. EWC databases: search the ETUI European Works Councils database (https://www.ewcdb.eu/) for Foot Locker. Record whether an EWC agreement exists, its date, its signatory unions, the countries covered and its coordinator federation (likely UNI Europa Commerce). Search UNI Europa / UNI Global Union news and the EWC coordinators' pages for 'Foot Locker' or 'Dick's' 2025-2026. If there is no EWC agreement, check for a Special Negotiating Body request since the deal; a change of control often triggers one.
2. Dutch OR channels: search LinkedIn posts by Jill Maclaren and any 'Ondernemingsraad Foot Locker' members, plus FNV Handel, CNV Vakmensen, De Unie and the 'OR-net' / ORnet.nl news, for 'Foot Locker' with adviesaanvraag, reorganisatie, overname, verkoop, 'Dick's Sporting Goods', Utrecht or Haps, 2025-2026. Check rechtspraak.nl Ondernemingskamer rulings (WOR art. 26 appeals) involving Foot Locker.
3. UWV / collectief ontslag: search Dutch news (DUIC, AD, RTV Utrecht, Omroep Brabant for Haps, Distrifood/Logistiek.nl, RetailTrends, Twinklemagazine, Fashion United NL) for 'Foot Locker' with reorganisatie, ontslagen, banen, 'hoofdkantoor Utrecht' or 'distributiecentrum Haps', 2026.
4. Belgium: search the ACV-Puls/BBTK-SETCa news pages and Belgian press (De Tijd, L'Echo, Gondola, RetailDetail) for 'Foot Locker' with ondernemingsraad/conseil d'entreprise, 'wet Renault/procédure Renault', sluiting or herstructurering, 2025-2026. Belgium's owned stores fell 20 → 17 → 14 (Dec-23 to Dec-25), so check whether a CAO/CCT or social plan was filed (FOD WASO collective-agreement database: https://www.werk.belgie.be, search 'Foot Locker' under PC 201/311).
5. Pan-EU HR signals: EMEA HR leadership changes (Ben Boylan, VP HR EMEA, left the UK board on 2026-06-04; who replaced him?). Look for LinkedIn job postings or reports for 'HR Business Partner Transformation', 'Employee Relations Europe' or similar at FL EMEA in 2026, and for interim/restructuring HR hires.

OUTPUT: source URL, date, verbatim quote (original language plus English), tier, and why it bears on a sale or licensing. Report explicit negatives, e.g. 'ewcdb has no Foot Locker agreement' or 'no rechtspraak.nl rulings'.

tasks.title: Spain/Portugal: regional unions beyond ELA, the REGCON collective-agreement registry and dating of Iberian closures
UK/Ireland: council planning portals and committee papers for FL lease surrenders, re-lets and new-store consents
tasks.instructions:
Goal: use local-authority primary documents (planning, advertisement-consent and licensing applications, and cabinet or committee papers on council-owned centres) to date FL UK and Ireland store exits and new commitments. This is a new modality; wave 1 used press and locators only. Context: the UK locator went 59 (Jul-22) → 57 → 56 → 53 (Nov-25) → 49 (Oct-26). Foot Locker U.K. Ltd's strategic report (signed 2025-11-24) planned 1 opening and 3 closures for 2026, and only GBP6.4m of UK lease commitments falls due after more than 5 years. Ireland has 5 stores left (O'Connell St, Henry St/Ilac, Blanchardstown, Swords, Limerick) after Grafton St and Tallaght closed around the deal.

ALREADY KNOWN (do not re-report without a new primary document): Chatham Pentagon Centre (closed week of 2026-07-20; Medway Council 'terms being agreed with new occupiers'); 442 Brixton Road (closed ~early Aug-2026, 'Unit To Let'); Bournemouth Castlepoint; Birmingham Perry Barr One Stop; Bullring Kids; Liverpool ONE relocation to the ex-Topshop on Church St (opened 2026-01-23); Telford opening; Glasgow Argyle St boarded Jan-2026 'reopening soon'.

STEPS:
1. Medway Council: search modern.gov committee and cabinet papers and decision notices (Pentagon Centre is council-owned) for 'Foot Locker' or the FL unit number. Look for a lease surrender, a dilapidations settlement, a re-let to a new tenant and any rent figures.
2. Planning and advertisement-consent portals (Idox Public Access and similar). Search 'Foot Locker' and 'former Foot Locker' in proposals or applicant names, 2024-2026, for: BCP Council (Castlepoint Unit 21 re-let), Lambeth (442 Brixton Road: change of use or new occupier), Liverpool (Church St / Keys Court shopfront and signage for FL, which shows when the lease was committed), Birmingham (Perry Barr One Stop, Bullring), Glasgow (Argyle St at Queen St: shopfront or refurbishment consent, refit vs exit), Westminster (Oxford Street), Leeds, Manchester (Arndale, Trafford Centre) and Telford. Then run a UK-wide sweep with Google, using 'site:' queries on known planning-portal domains or the planning aggregators (e.g. planit.org.uk API: https://www.planit.org.uk/api/applics/json?search=Foot%20Locker&recent=730), and list every 2025-26 application naming Foot Locker. New-store or refit consents count as AGAINST evidence; applications by a new occupier at an ex-FL unit date an exit.
3. Business-rates / VOA: check the VOA rating list (https://www.tax.service.gov.uk/business-rates-find/) for occupier and description changes at the target addresses, where visible.
4. Ireland: search Dublin City Council, South Dublin County Council (The Square, Tallaght), Fingal (Blanchardstown, Swords) and Limerick planning portals (ePlanning.ie) for 'Foot Locker' / 'former Foot Locker' 2024-2026. Search Irish press (Irish Times, Irish Independent, Business Post, Limerick Leader, Echo.ie) for 'Foot Locker' closure, and the Mandate trade union for any FL Ireland statement.
5. Reconcile the UK count. Drapers' Dec-2025 '59 UK stores' vs the locator's 49 vs ScrapeHero's 51 (2026-05-07): explain the basis (e.g. Kids FL, outlets, NI, Freedom Sportsline) using primary sources if possible.

OUTPUT per item: council or portal reference number, document URL, date, verbatim extract, store and address, inferred lease-exit or commitment date, and tier (council and planning documents = A). Report explicit negatives per council.
